title: Handle missing data
summary: R: Handle missing data. Add another NA. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: NA marks a missing value. is.na detects it. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: Install R. Save an example as lesson.R and run Rscript lesson.R, or paste it into the R console.
is.na is true only at the missing position. sum counts that one true value.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Do not compare with == NA; use is.na.
